sn6.10:4.2: “Last night, mendicants, the divinity Sahampati, glorious in the last part of the night, lighting up the entire Jeta’s Grove, came to me; coming up, he bowed to me and stood to one side. Standing to one side, mendicants, the divinity Sahampati said to me:
sn6.10:4.4: He was reborn in the Pink Lotus hell because of his resentment for Sāriputta and Moggallāna.”
sn6.10:4.5: That is what the divinity Sahampati said, mendicants; then he bowed to me, and respectfully circled keeping me on his right, before vanishing right there”.
